surface.name: Admin: Orders
surface.body: Internal tool for the operations team to browse, inspect, and refund placed orders. Renders inside the admin shell at `/admin/orders`.

region.name: Orders table
region.role: Paginated, filterable table of recent orders.

region.name: Order detail pane
region.role: Right-side pane showing the selected order's line items, payment, and shipment status.

region.name: Refund modal
region.role: Operator-initiated refund flow. Calls into with a negative amount.
